textAndButtonBannerData.ctaTitle: Ready to save time and launch 10X faster?
textAndButtonBannerData.ctaDescription: Let us help you! It's as simple as it should be to integrate guest verification, payment collections, and automated payouts into your hospitality platform.

data.text: Let guests verify their identity in seconds with Decentro's UIDAI-certified OVSE (Offline Verification Seeking Entity) service. This QR-based consent flow authenticates guests against Aadhaar in seconds, no OTPs, no manual form-filling at the desk, enabling frictionless self-serve kiosk and app-based check-ins.

Auto-populate the Guest Registration Card and maintain a compliant, digitally auditable register for every guest, domestic or foreign, cutting manual data entry at the reception desk. Ensure accurate, retrievable identity data is on hand for local police verification, FRRO reporting, and internal audits across all properties.

Collect advance bookings, room payments, and add-on charges via UPI, cards, and payment links, and route funds from multiple OTAs and channel partners into dedicated virtual accounts for instant, automated reconciliation. Eliminate manual matching and gain real-time visibility into every payment across every booking channel.

Verify PAN and GSTIN for corporate travel desks and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) bookings, so invoicing, TDS, and GST credit stay audit-ready from the first transaction. Streamline billing workflows for large group reservations and ensure every corporate booking is compliant from day one.

Automate payouts to housekeeping and F&B vendors, travel agent commissions, and staff reimbursements via UPI, IMPS, NEFT, or RTGS, with full reconciliation against each booking or invoice. Reduce manual effort, eliminate payout delays, and maintain a clear audit trail for every disbursement across your hospitality operations.

Give hotel groups and franchise operators a single API layer to standardise guest verification, collections, and settlements across properties, instead of stitching together bank-specific integrations at each location. Achieve operational consistency, centralised reporting, and faster onboarding for new properties joining the network.

faqs.question: Does Decentro help hotels stay compliant with guest registration and police reporting requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes. Decentro's KYC APIs help populate the Guest Registration Card for every guest and maintain digitally auditable identity records, so hotels have accurate, retrievable data on hand for local police verification and internal audits. Foreign guest reporting to the FRRO still needs to be filed by the hotel, but Decentro ensures the underlying identity data is verified, accurate, and instantly available.

faqs.question: Can Decentro handle payment collections across multiple OTAs and booking channels?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Decentro's virtual account and payment collection APIs let you accept payments via UPI, cards, and payment links across your website, app, and OTA partners, while automatically reconciling each payment against the right booking, property, or channel — no manual matching required.

faqs.question: How does Decentro support vendor and staff payouts for hotels?
faqs.answer: Decentro automates payouts to vendors, travel agents, and staff via UPI, IMPS, NEFT, or RTGS, with each payout reconciled against the relevant invoice or booking. This works across single properties as well as multi-property hotel groups and franchises.

faqs.question: Is Decentro's guest verification process compliant with India's data protection requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes. Decentro's identity verification flows are built around consent-based, minimal data collection in line with the DPDPA. For OVSE-collected Aadhaar data, any onward sharing with a third party requires written disclosure of who the recipient is and why, explicit granular consent from the guest for that specific sharing, and guaranteed end-to-end deletion (with acknowledgement) if the guest later revokes consent — so hotels stay compliant even when data needs to move between systems (e.g., PMS, channel manager, police reporting tools).
